Overview

This feature service contains a municipal road centerline layer for The District of Peachland area in the BC. It provides a structured road network dataset that supports street reference, addressing, and local transportation mapping.

Feature Layers

  • PCH Georoads: A road centerline layer with road names, road type, direction, full street name, and address range information for both sides of the street. 

Geographic Coverage

The service covers The District of Peachland in British Columbia within the Regional District of Central Okanagan.

Use Cases

  • Street and route reference in GIS applications
  • Address range lookup and civic addressing support
  • Local transportation and road network mapping
  • Municipal data maintenance and operational planning
